stats.figure: Resident investors were 56.6% of all Dubai property investors in 2025 (193.1 thousand investors in total).
stats.source: Dubai Land Department, via Dubai Media Office

stats.figure: Renters took on average 4.8 years to become property investors.
stats.source: Dubai Land Department, via Dubai Media Office

stats.figure: UAE residents were 45% of the 59,075 new investors in the first half of 2025.
stats.source: Dubai Land Department, via Dubai Media Office
stats.basis: new investors, a different base from the 56.6% of all investors

stats.figure: Off-plan was 71% of 87,800 deals in the first half of 2026.
stats.source: Provident Estate press release, via Zawya (a developer and broker, not the Land Department)

stats.figure: 500 homes sold at US$10 million or more in 2025 (143 in the last quarter).
stats.source: Knight Frank, Dubai residential market review Q4 2025

stats.figure: 1,417 transactions above AED 15 million in the second quarter of 2025.

Of 70,000+ off-plan homes resold before handover (2009 to 2026), the median gross gain was 9.1% after a median 19 months; about 4.1% after roughly 5% costs. These are past medians of those who resold, not what any buyer will get.
stats.source: Smart Bricks study, via Khaleej Times

stats.figure: Dubai's population was 4,807,185 in late September 2026, against 4,580,300 at the end of 2025.
stats.source: Dubai Data and Statistics Establishment, via Gulf News

stats.figure: Off-plan was 74.3% of unit sales from 1 October 2025 to 30 September 2026 in our 44 area files (101,515 of 136,680); 70.8% the year before.
stats.source: Our own count of Dubai Land Department sales records (44 area files, not the whole city)
